about: Pins for the interactive map (tools/site_guides.py interactive_map). 'at' = a place name printed on Rockstar's official map or its grid cell (studio.mappins.where); dx/dy nudge the pin (fractions of the map). Every spot needs 2+ guides in 'src'; say so in the text when guides disagree. No story spoilers, nothing from leaks, nothing sexualized.

en.d: The neon heart of Leonida, Rockstar's Miami: beaches, nightlife, money and chaos.

es.d: El corazón de neón de Leonida, la Miami de Rockstar: playas, vida nocturna, dinero y caos.

en.d: Islands and bridges inspired by the Florida Keys: boats, sunsets and laid-back island towns.

es.d: Islas y puentes inspirados en los Cayos de Florida: barcos, atardeceres y pueblos tranquilos.

en.d: Leonida's wetlands, Rockstar's Everglades: swamps, airboats and alligators.

es.d: Los pantanos de Leonida, los Everglades de Rockstar: aerodeslizadores y caimanes.

en.d: A fading beach-resort town on the Gulf coast, with its glory days behind it.

es.d: Un pueblo de playa venido a menos en la costa del Golfo.

en.d: An industrial town built around a sugar refinery, with a rough biker scene.

es.d: Un pueblo industrial alrededor de una refinería de azúcar, con ambiente motero.

en.d: The wild north: forests, trails and back roads for off-roading and hunting.

es.d: El norte salvaje: bosques, senderos y caminos de tierra.

en.d: A tall radio mast in Bluegrass, north of Hamlet; some guides say South Vice-Dale. Climb to the top.

es.d: Una antena de radio alta en Bluegrass, al norte de Hamlet; algunas guías dicen South Vice-Dale. Sube hasta arriba.

en.d: Kelly County, northwest of the Starlet Motel near Port Gellhorn, after 2 AM. It doesn't happen every night; one guide places it just east of Port Gellhorn.

es.d: Kelly County, al noroeste del Starlet Motel, cerca de Port Gellhorn, después de las 2 AM. No pasa todas las noches; una guía lo sitúa al este de Port Gellhorn.

en.d: Leonida's Bigfoot, around Cottonmouth Lake in Grassrivers, south of Hamlet.

es.d: El Pie Grande de Leonida, alrededor de Cottonmouth Lake en Grassrivers, al sur de Hamlet.

en.d: A nod to the TV series Dexter on Washington Island, east of Vice City. You can't go inside.

es.d: Un guiño a la serie Dexter en Washington Island, al este de Vice City. No se puede entrar.

en.d: An abandoned research station in Pelican Valley (Gullet Marsh).

es.d: Una estación de investigación abandonada en Pelican Valley (Gullet Marsh).

en.t: Cool Dog on a jet ski
en.d: Out on the open water; the reported starting area is Gambit Bay, west of Key Lento.

es.t: Cool Dog en moto de agua
es.d: En mar abierto; la zona de salida reportada es Gambit Bay, al oeste de Key Lento.

en.d: A villa garage on Vespucci Island (Rialto Islands): a car styled like his Fast & Furious Eclipse (guides list it as a Maibatsu Penumbra). Guides disagree on how to get in.

es.d: Un garaje de una villa en Vespucci Island (Rialto Islands): un coche al estilo de su Eclipse de Fast & Furious (las guías dicen Maibatsu Penumbra). No coinciden en cómo entrar.
